/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/VenusD.description: Patrols the Vallis and reports any suspicious activity back to command.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Vip/Ve.name: Corpus Cestra Target
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Vip/Ve.description: This high-profile unit is armed with Dual Cestras.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Vip/Ve.name: Corpus Trencher Target
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Vip/Ve.description: With brutal melee attacks, this target does not back down.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Vip/Ve.name: Corpus Supra Target
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Vip/Ve.description: A modified Supra makes this high-value target highly dangerous.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Vip/Ve.name: Corpus Sniper Target
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Vip/Ve.description: A Taxmen VIP marked for assassination, armed with a high-powered sniper rifle.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Ambulas/.name: Condor Storm Dropship
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Ambulas/.description: Reinforced Condor used to transport elite personnel into conflict zone.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Ambulas/.name: Ambulas
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Ambulas/.description: This reborn Ambulas has been upgraded to become one of the most lethal combat proxies.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.name: Profit-Taker Orb
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.description: Monster of the Vallis and protector of Enrichment Labs, this massive Orb appears to be invulnerable.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.name: Exploiter Orb
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.description: Exploiter harvests energy from the landscape and uses storms of ice and snow to safeguard the Temple of Profit from trespassers.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.name: Coolant Raknoid
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.description: Often found near the Exploiter Orb, these Raknoids carry deep-ice coolant that they use to protect themselves while harvesting Thermia fractures.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.name: Scyto Raknoid
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.description: This mid-sized Raknoid is highly mobile and attacks by latching onto prey with a grappling hook or spitting deadly fluid from its sac.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.name: Kyta Raknoid
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.description: A large Raknoid, with multiple attact vectors that is most frequently deployed during high alert levels.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Hyena/Hy.name: Hyena TH
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Hyena/Hy.description: Charging attacks with a Power Drain and HUD Scrambling Aura

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Hyena/Hy.name: Hyena NG
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Hyena/Hy.description: Heavy AoE attacks with a Heat Resistance Aura

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Hyena/Hy.name: Hyena PB
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Hyena/Hy.description: Long range attacks with Shield Recharge Aura

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Hyena/Hy.name: Hyena LN2
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Hyena/Hy.description: Strong Melee attacks with a Slow Aura

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Zariman/CrpI.name: Derivator Crewman
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Zariman/CrpI.description: Using the latest in Corpus weapons technology, this Crewman absorbs damage, until it unleashes it all in a powerful shockwave. The Derivator unit is mounted on the back.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.name: Ved Xol
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.description: Ved Xol was nominated to become the head of the Loan Reclamation Division at Anyo Corp. after demonstrating ruthless aptitude within the Index. He has obtained favorable results with his team on many occasions, and is a firm favourite amongst corporate backers.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.name: Nako Xol
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.description: The younger brother of Ved Xol displayed no aptitude for business. Instead, his enthusiasm for violence and conflict have helped him quickly climb corporate ranks.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.name: Pelna Cade
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.description: Pelna Cade is a skilled technician who graduated with the Xol brothers. Remaining close friends with the family following their military service together, he now works for them to keep the robotics in their service in peak condition.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.name: Lockjaw & Sol
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.description: The Loan Reclamation Division worked closely with Alad V on several ventures during his tenure on the Corpus Board of Directors. Despite his involuntary retirement, it is speculated that the Xol Brothers still undertake assignments on his behalf. These robots, based on Alad V's own patented designs were delivered as payment for services rendered and only serve to strengthen such suspicions.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.name: Jad Teran
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.description: A young and ambitious Anyo Corp. employee, Jad has demonstrated remarkable aptitude for micromanaging machinery. He was promoted to the Robotics Technology Division where he leads the design of new robotics to be utilized by other divisions of Anyo Corp.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.name: Raptor Rx
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.description: The Index marks the debut of the X-series of the Raptor. This version of armoured Osprey doubles as both a mobile accounting system and security detail for the brokers employed by Anyo Corp.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.name: Auditor
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.description: A heavily modified model of Denial Bursas, designed for the secure transferral of offline funds. This armoured robot protects the financial interests of Anyo Corp.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.name: Jen Dro
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.description: Jen specializes in corporate espionage and uses the information she gathers to facilitate sudden downturns for her opponents.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.name: M-W.A.M.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.description: The Multi-Weapon Assault Moa is equipped with a number of weapons to assist the brokers employed by Zenith Galactical with endeavors.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.name: Derim Zahn
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.description: A digital virtuoso, Derim is a capable hacker who applies his trade laundering funds traded through the Index.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.name: Tia Mayn
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.description: Tia supports her allies by providing them with effective exit strategies when a deal takes a turn for the worse. These strategies often leave the other party with significant medical fees.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.name: Armis Ulta
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.description: As the Chief Officer of the Investor Relations department, Armis pressures investors into accepting Nef Anyo's invitation to The Index. He's also adept at leveraging investor debt to make maximum profit for Anyo Corp.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.name: Dru Pesfor
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.description: A senior Analysts, Dru addresses all complaints received from colonists in person - with a high-grade, rubedo-lined laser cannon.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.name: Rana Del
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.description: More than just a broker, Rana is a hostile customer relations specialist. When investors refuse to pay their debts, they can look forward to a visit from her.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.name: 002-ER
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.description: Designed to execute the 002 Eradication Protocol, this Osprey identifies high-risk brokers and administers injury.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corrupted/Corrupted.name: Corrupted Drahk Master
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corrupted/Corrupted.description: He came in search of Void treasure, the Orokin Neural Sentry had other plans.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Entrati/Doppelgange.name: Mocking Whisper
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Entrati/Doppelgange.description: This mocking phantom emerges to persecute the one who unwisely looked into its book, cutting deeply with hatred and blows alike. The book it arose from is its one vulnerability.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Entrati/Doppelgange.name: Scathing Whisper
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Entrati/Doppelgange.description: Looking too deeply into Albrecht's lost grimoires may cause a void-born duplicate to appear, seething with contempt for the one who let it loose and hurling its wrath from afar. It cannot be banished until the book that gave rise to it is destroyed.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Avat.name: Nightwatch Bombard
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Avat.description: Brings devastation with a modified Ogris.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Beas.name: Drahk Master
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Beas.description: Summons Drahk to fight for it

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/CatM.name: Hyekka Master
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/CatM.description: Summons Hyekka to fight for it

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Comb.name: Hyekka
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Comb.description: Trained to hunt down the Infestation

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Comb.name: Drahk
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Comb.description: Thick dermal plates adorn its hide

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Elit.name: Elite Shield Lancer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Elit.description: Carries an impenetrable shield and fires granades.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Grin.name: Bailiff
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Grin.description: Charges foes with devastating melee attacks

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Grin.name: Drudge Foreman
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Grin.description: Oversees the tasks performed by other drudges.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Grin.name: Drudge Scrapper
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Grin.description: Proficient with tools used for grinding.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Jetp.name: Nightwatch Reaver
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Jetp.description: Highly mobile and heavily armored, this unit spreads mayhem with his modified Tonkor.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Mach.name: Scorpion
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Mach.description: Lethal melee unit with ranged harpoon attack

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Nigh.name: Nightwatch Hyekka Master
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Nigh.description: Leads a pack of Hyekka into battle.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Nigh.name: Nightwatch Flameblade
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Nigh.description: Assailing enemies with the Twin Basolk, this combatant closes in on its target with teleportation technology.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Nigh.name: Nightwatch Bailiff
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Nigh.description: Swings a Jat Kittag as he runs down his foes.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Nigh.name: Nightwatch Seeker
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Nigh.description: Distracts prey with rollers while taking aim with a high-calibre Marelok.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Nigh.name: Nightwatch Gunner
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Nigh.description: Brings devastation with a modified Ogris.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Nigh.name: Nightwatch Powerclaw
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Nigh.description: Sporting the visceral Ripkas, this unit is a specialist in close quarter combat.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Nigh.name: Nightwatch Lancer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Nigh.description: These mobile infantry make up the core of the Nightwatch Corps.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Nigh.name: Nightwatch Brunt Lancer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Nigh.description: Blocks hostile gunfire with a reinforced Brunt.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Pist.name: Powerfist
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Pist.description: Slow but very powerful melee attacks

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/ChemStrike/.name: Nox
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/ChemStrike/.description: Toxic to the core, Nox lobs exploding poison goo at enemies. Rupture his helmet to expose his head but beware of the unleashed noxious gasses.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/DeathSquad/.name: Vem Tabook
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/DeathSquad/.description: A member of the infamous Grustrag Three

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/DeathSquad/.name: Leekter
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/DeathSquad/.description: A member of the infamous Grustrag Three

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/DeathSquad/.name: Shik Tal
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/DeathSquad/.description: A member of the infamous Grustrag Three

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Disruption/.name: Demolisher Devourer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Disruption/.description: Demolishers are explosive enemies with a single-minded purpose: the destruction of compromised conduits at any cost. Part of the complete Alad V Conduit Security Package!

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Disruption/.name: Demolisher Expired

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Disruption/.name: Demolisher Kuva Guardian
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Disruption/.description: Demolishers are explosive enemies with a single-minded purpose: the destruction of compromised conduits at any cost. Part of the complete Alad V Conduit Security Package!

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Eid.name: Akkalak Turret
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Eid.description: Fires armor-shattering shells at a rapid rate.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Eid.name: Mordda Turret
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Eid.description: A long-range battery that fires destructive ordnance.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Eid.name: Tusk Mortar Bombard
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Eid.description: This Bombard's portable, back-mounted mortar allows the Grineer to rain destruction anywhere on the plains.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Eid.name: Dargyn Pilot
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Eid.description: Hardy and quick-thinking, as formidable outside his Dargyn as in.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Gri.name: Tusk Ogma
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Gri.description: Retrofitted for Plains operations, the Tusk-variant Ogma IDs targets at range, hammers out missile volleys on approach and finishes the job with a rain of explosives.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Gri.name: Tusk Bolkor
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Gri.description: The pride of the Tusk fleet, the Bolkor is the ideal platform from which to mount ground operations. Equipped with a high capacity rotary canon, densely plated and with enough space to carry a platoon, the Bolkor holds its own raining down fire and dropping squad after squad at regular intervals.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Gri.name: Tusk Firbolg
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Gri.description: In and out under extreme duress, the Firbolg handles lightning fast infiltrations/extractions and lazy picket duty with equal aplomb.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Gri.name: Tusk Shield Dargyn
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Gri.description: Inflicts moderate damage at a fast rate

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Gri.name: Tusk Dargyn
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Gri.description: Inflicts moderate damage at a fast rate

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Vip.name: Recon Commander
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Vip.description: Agile and quick-witted, as patient as she is cunning.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Vip.name: Plains Commander
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Vip.description: One of the faceless Grineer ranks.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Vip.name: Tusk Carabus
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Vip.description: Fires a devastating heat ray and self destructs.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Vip.name: Aerial Commander
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Vip.description: A rugged career pilot, bred to survive on the Plains.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Vip.name: Tusk Command Dargyn
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Vip.description: Armed with a high-velocity rapid-fire cannon, this armored skiff tears up targets and terrain alike.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Vom.name: Eidolon Lure
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Eidolon/Vom.description: A Grineer device meant to lure in Vomvalysts and trap their energy.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Forest/Grin.name: Frontier Bailiff
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Forest/Grin.description: Charges foes with devastating melee attacks

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Fortress/Av.name: Kuva Dargyn
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Fortress/Av.description: Missiles seek out targets and inflict high damage

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Fortress/Fo.name: Kuva Drahk Master
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Fortress/Fo.description: Summons Drahk to fight for it

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Fortress/Fo.name: Kuva Hyekka Master
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Fortress/Fo.description: Summons Hyekka to fight for it

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Fortress/Fo.name: Kuva Hyekka
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Fortress/Fo.description: Trained to hunt down the Infestation

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Fortress/Fo.name: Kuva Drahk
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Fortress/Fo.description: Thick dermal plates adorn its hide

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Fortress/Fo.name: Bailiff
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Fortress/Fo.description: The finest Bailiff clones are chosen to serve in the Queen's Fortress

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Fortress/Fo.name: Kuva Scorpion
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Fortress/Fo.description: Lethal melee unit with ranged harpoon attack

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Fortress/Fo.name: Kuva Powerclaw
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Fortress/Fo.description: Slow but very powerful melee attacks

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.name: Ghoul Devourer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.description: Vay Hek's personal favorite, the Devourer is a maximal terror unit. Draped in shreds of the diapause bag that birthed it, this gap-mawed monstrosity barrels toward prey with furious intensity.\n\nWrist-mounted hooks are welded to elbow joints and hyperpowered by a myotechnical winch system for maximum impact-and-pull.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.name: Ghoul Auger
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.description: Known colloquially as the 'drill sergeant', the Augur is fast-grown into its enhancements. As with all Ghouls, no regard is given to the proper development of its higher functions.\n\nCantilevered leg augments propel the unit toward the fray at speed, while over- and undermounted extendable drill carriages magnify both reach and penetrating power.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.name: Ghoul Expired
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.description: The Expired are Ghouls who have succumbed to malnutrition or enviromental poisoning during the early stages of development. Their backup nervous systems continue to drive them forward, however, making them ideal suicide troops.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.name: Ghoul Rictus
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.description: So named for its terrifying leer, the Rictus (AKA 'the Sawman') lives to divide and conquer its foes - literally.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Vip/.name: Ghoul Auger Alpha
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Vip/.description: Whether through aberrant cognition or sheer brutality one specimen always moves to the front of each pack. It is from this individual that the other units take their dead.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Vip/.name: Ghoul Rictus Alpha
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Vip/.description: This specimen shows evidence of advanced cognitive abilities and greater, if rudimentary, situational analysis. Cold blooded and ruthless, it is easy to see how this specimen led its pack so ably.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Narmer/Avat.name: Narmer Lancer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Narmer/Avat.description: The Narmer Veil is in full control.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Narmer/Narm.name: Tusk Seeker Drone
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Narmer/Narm.description: Identifies potential threats and calls in reinforcements.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/Ad.name: Lektro Commander
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/Ad.description: A Grineer Commander specializing in electrical weaponry.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/Ad.name: Blite Captain
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/Ad.description: A Grineer Captain specializing in toxic weaponry.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/Av.name: Pyr Captain
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/Av.description: A Grineer Captain specializing in thermal weaponry.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/Av.name: Glacik Commander
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/Av.description: A Grineer Captain specializing in freezing weaponry.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/De.name: Exo Raider
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/De.description: Part of a Grineer Ramsled boarding party, packing a cluster missile launcher.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/De.name: Exo Raider Carver
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/De.description: Part of a Grineer Ramsled boarding party. Wields two melee sawblades, and is a relentless pursuer.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/De.name: Exo Raider Eviscerator
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/De.description: Part of a Grineer Ramsled boarding party. Uses a sawblades weapon capable of firing ricocheting projectiles.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/De.name: Exo Gokstad Officer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/De.description: The commanding officer of a Gokstad crewship. Wields a Karak Wraith and has the ability to spawn Roller Sentries.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/De.name: Exo Butcher

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/Gr.description: Part of a Grineer Ramsled boarding party. Wields two melee sawblades, and is a relentless pursuer.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/Gr.description: Part of a Grineer Ramsled boarding party. Uses a sawblades weapon capable of firing ricocheting projectiles.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/SeaLab/Grin.description: Lethal melee unit with ranged harpoon attack

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/SpecialEven.name: Regulator
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/SpecialEven.description: Grants nearby Grineer units extra speed and damage

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Thumper/Thu.name: Tusk Thumper
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Thumper/Thu.description: Grineer mobile defense platform. Pneumatic groundpounders, high-drop entrances and wide-bore cannons deliver the same simple message: boom.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Thumper/Thu.name: Tusk Thumper Doma
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Thumper/Thu.description: The largest version of the Grineer mobile defense platform. Pneumatic groundpounders, high-drop entrances and wide-bore cannons deliver the same simple message: boom.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Thumper/Thu.name: Tusk Thumper Bull
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Thumper/Thu.description: An upsized version of the Grineer mobile defense platform. Pneumatic groundpounders, high-drop entrances and wide-bore cannons deliver the same simple message: boom.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/Hek/Pro.name: Disruptor Drone
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/Hek/Pro.description: Boosts Grineer morale while weakening enemies.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/RoyalJe.name: Kuva Jester
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/RoyalJe.description: Small and agile, jumps onto its prey

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/VorRewo.name: Cannon Battery
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/VorRewo.description: Inflicts moderate damage at a fast rate

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/VorTwo/.name: Corrupted Vor
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/VorTwo/.description: I was cut in half, destroyed, but through its Janus Key, the Void called to me. It brought me here and here I was reborn\n\n-Vor

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Zariman/Grn.name: Kuva Trokarian
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Zariman/Grn.description: The Worm Queen's early presence aboard the Zariman has aided her troops' defenses. Through Reliquary tampering, The Worm Queen has bestowed these troopers with a miniature Kuva Trokar to disrupt transference.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Gr.name: Executioner Vay Molta
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Gr.description: Highly maneuverable combatant with devastating attacks.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Anc.name: Ancient Disruptor
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Anc.description: Heavy melee unit with a disrupting attack.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Anc.name: Brood Mother
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Anc.description: Spawns maggots that attack its target

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Anc.name: Ancient Healer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Anc.description: Heavy melee that applies damage reduction buff to allies.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Anc.name: Ancient Protector
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Anc.description: Heavy melee unit that protects allies with Overguard, or damage reduction if Tenno.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Anc.name: Boiler
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Anc.description: Riddled with boils that erupt into spawn pods when hit

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Anc.name: Arcane Boiler
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Anc.description: Riddled with boils that erupt into spawn pods when hit

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Anc.name: Toxic Ancient
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Anc.description: Heavy melee unit that lashes out with a toxic flail.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Cra.name: Electric Crawler
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Cra.description: Shock nearby enemies with a bio-electrical attack

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Cra.name: Toxic Crawler
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Cra.description: Releases a poison cloud on death

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Emi.name: Deimos Therid
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Emi.description: The cunning Therid uses its long arms to spin a ball of corrosive gossamer that it hurls with a surprising force. It has also been known to scoop up smaller infested to throw at intruders as an improvised projectile/delivery system.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Emi.name: Leaping Thrasher
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Emi.description: An ancient brute possessed of a weighty arm-flail and the terrifying strength to use it to devastating effect. Its lumbering form belies shocking speed, which the Leaping Thrasher achieves by slamming its arm into the ground and throwing itself into battle.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Emi.name: Undying Flyer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Emi.description: An Infested jetpack trooper, the Undying Flyer rams opponents at high speed. When killed it reverts to a pod-state. If not destroyed the Undying Flyer emerges at full health.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Gre.name: Deimos Jugulus
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Gre.description: A writhing tower of flesh and gristle, the Jugulus lurks beneath the surface and emerges to launch streams of organic projectiles from its wide maw.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Gre.name: Deimos Saxum
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Gre.description: Saxum are bipedal, medium-sized assailants capable of short-ranged attacks and a powerful grand slam in melee.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Inf.name: Tar Mutalist MOA
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Inf.description: Discharges tar-like mucus slowing its prey

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Qua.name: Carrion Charger
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Qua.description: Spawned the body of a creature killed by infested, these charges are fast with weak claw attacks.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Run.name: Volatile Runner
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Run.description: Fast and explodes when near enemies

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Wea.name: Zealoid Bastion
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Wea.description: A subordinate loyal to the Zealoid Prelate, the Bastion renders regular Infested invulnerable.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Wea.name: Zealoid Prelate
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Wea.description: Wreathed in an obfuscating black cloud the Zealoid Prelate brings Arlo's word with fire, blood and loyal Bastions who spring to his aid.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/Disruption.name: Demolisher Thrasher
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/Disruption.description: Demolishers are explosive enemies with a single-minded purpose: the destruction of compromised conduits at any cost. Part of the complete Alad V Conduit Security Package!

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/Disruption.name: Demolisher Boiler
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/Disruption.description: Demolishers are explosive enemies with a single-minded purpose: the destruction of compromised conduits at any cost. Part of the complete Alad V Conduit Security Package!

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/Disruption.name: Demolisher Juggernaut
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/Disruption.description: Demolishers are explosive enemies with a single-minded purpose: the destruction of compromised conduits at any cost. Part of the complete Alad V Conduit Security Package!

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/Disruption.name: Demolisher Charger
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/Disruption.description: Demolishers are explosive enemies with a single-minded purpose: the destruction of compromised conduits at any cost. Part of the complete Alad V Conduit Security Package!

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Deimos Leaping Thrasher
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: An ancient brute possessed of a weighty arm-flail and the terrifying strength to use it to devastating effect. Its lumbering form belies shocking speed, which the Leaping Thrasher achieves by slamming its arm into the ground and throwing itself into battle.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Deimos Carnis
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: Carnis are many-legged hunters, ferocious and ever-hungry. They scuttle just out of reach trying to wear down their prey with ranged attacks until they can rush in to consume it.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Deimos Carnis Rex
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: The Carnis Rex is a true terror, a monstrously-large Carnis. The Carneis Rex rushes headlong upon their prey, often coiling into a spinning wheel in its haste to come to grips.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Deimos Mutalist Osprey Carrier
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: Carries energy cells

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Latrox Une
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: Marooned Corpus researcher, unwilling resident on Deimos and ally-of-circumstance to the Entrati. Happy to see a non-Infested face.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Deimos Brood Mother
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: Spawns maggots that attack its target

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Deimos Tendril Drone
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: An infested drone as brutal and unforgiving as Deimos itself.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Deimos Genetrix
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: Genetrix act as mobile wombs for the Infested hordes, discharging swarms of Infested whenever they detect a non-Infested intruder. A Genetrix prominent sensor stalk must be disabled or avoided to stem a seemingly unending tide of monsters.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Deimos Saxum Rex
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: Saxum Rex are larger, meaner Saxum and represent a considerably enhanced threat. How they achieve this evolution is unknown, but cannibalism is suspected.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Deimos Ancient Healer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: Heavy melee that applies damage reduction buff to allies.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Deimos Venin Mutalist
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: Fires infested spores

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Deimos Juggernaut
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: Protected by impenetrable armor.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Polyp-Hog Juggernaut
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: With the ability to track a scent from miles away, this Juggernaut is an invaluable ally when foraging rare Polyps from the ruins of Deimos

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Deimos Runner
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: Fast with weak claw attacks

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Deimos Swarm Mutalist MOA
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: Discharges swarms of infested spores

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Deimos Undying Flyer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: An Infested jetpack trooper, the Undying Flyer rams opponents at high speed. When killed it reverts to a pod-state. If not destroyed the Undying Flyer emerges at full health.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Deimos Charger
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: Fast with weak claw attacks

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Mitosid
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: When pressured, this beast severs it's torso from its legs, yielding double trouble for its victims.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Mitosid Rex
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: Fiercely territorial, this beast lurks within the ruins of Deimos.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Basal Diploid
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: Deaf, Dumb and Blind, it hunts prey using vibrations from the surrounding environment.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Basal Diploid Rex
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: Deaf, Dumb and Blind, it hunts prey using vibrations from the surrounding environment.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Feral Diploid
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: Dismembered, but deadly nonetheless. It's acrobatic movement makes it threatening from any range.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: Feral Diploid Rex
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.description: Dismembered, but deadly nonetheless. It's acrobatic movement makes it threatening from any range.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/SpecialEve.name: Zealot Proselytizer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/SpecialEve.description: Attacking with blade and gun, this Zealot spreads the 'message' with a hive of toxic, explosive pustules that grow on his back when he is attacked.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/SpecialEve.name: Zealot Herald
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/SpecialEve.description: This Zealot targets petential converts with a spray of toxic sludge.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/SpecialEve.name: Zealot Baptizer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/SpecialEve.description: From Arlo the promise of a new life, a new form and a new word: death.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Murmur.name: The Unseeing Herald
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Murmur.description: The Unseeing Herald proclaims the will of the Indifference, uttering its twisted desires in Voidtongue. Who among us have heard its whispers?

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Octope.name: Hurling Fragment
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Octope.description: Clings to the cliffs and walls, hurling masonry on anything unfortunate enough to be traveling below.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Octope.name: Shuffling Fragment
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Octope.description: In its calcified chaos, the Indifference is disjointed even from itself.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Octope.name: The Fragmented
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Octope.description: On the rare occasions when Murmur fragments assemble themselves into a whole, the result is a monstrous and potent entity. It may manifest into three different forms, the Suzerain, Zelator and Anchorite, with a fourth form, the 'Fragmented One', being the most formidable of all. Together, as heralds of the Indifference, they tether down the Strands of Khra which their bizarre master must travel.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Treasu.name: Gruzzling
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Treasu.description: These greedy little Murmur tricksters love to steal Conduit Dockets and other coveted items from Albrecht's labs.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/VialCa.name: Vitriol Necramite
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/VialCa.description: An Entrat maintenance drone carring a phial of corrosive solution, to top up laboratory devices

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.name: Scrofa Drover Bursa
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.description: A Bursa unit that corrals its prey for rapid destruction.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.name: Scrofa Crewman
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.description: A seasoned combatant specializing in subterranean warfrare.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.name: Scrofa Attack Drone
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.description: An attack drone that deploys a heat-based aerosol before pummeling targets.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.name: Scrofa Shield Osprey
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.description: An Osprey that recharges the shields of it's allies.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.name: Scrofa Elite Crewman
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.description: An elite combatant that controls the battlefield through a combination of teleportation and decoy deployment.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.name: Scrofa Legionary
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.description: A quick-moving uniit that closes the distance with it's target through a bettering shield, before striking with it's hammer.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.name: Scrofa Laser MOA
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.description: A quick-moving Moa, armed with a laser disc weapon.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.name: Scrofa Heavy Trencher
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.description: A large hatchet and flying charge attacks make this heavy unit a capable foe.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.name: Scrofa Mite Raknoid
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.description: A diminutive Raknoid that can close large distances with it's jumping attack.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.name: Scrofa Lythrum Raknoid
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.description: This mid-sized Raknoid spits immobilizing fluid from it's sac before latching onto prey with it's grappling hook.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.name: Scrofa Railgun Moa
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.description: A Moa unit that fires from range while laying mines.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.name: Scrofa Grenadier Crewman
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.description: A seasoned combatant that utilizes multiple grenade types to deal heavy damage.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.name: Scrofa Shockwave Moa
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.description: A Moa unit capable of creating a powerful shockwave by stomping it's foot.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.name: Scrofa Plasmor Crewman
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.description: A shotgun wielding combatant specializing in subterranean warfare.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.name: Scrofa Sniper Ranger
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.description: A unit that deploys turrets and fires deadly shots from afar using it's laser cannon.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.name: Scrofa Decoy MOA
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Agents/.description: Facilitates weapon testing for the Jackal.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.name: Scrofa Armaments Director
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.description: Director of the Subterranean Armaments Division. Responsible for all research into weapons that can more effectively combat all things fungal.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.name: Scrofa Joro Raknoid
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.description: A large Raknoid, with multiple attack vectors that is most frequently deployed during high alert levels.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.name: Scrofa Strike Director
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.description: Director of the Subterranean Strike Division. Responcible for coordinating attacks on targets that drw Nef Anyo's ire.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.name: Scrofa Research Chief
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.description: Chief technology officer of the Subterranean Research Division. Responcible for reaserching Syzygy energy to the benefit of Nef Anyo.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.name: Scrofa Energy Chief
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.description: Chief researcher officer of the Subterranean Energy Division. Responcible for producing new methods of energy production to fuel Nef Anyo's ambitions.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/OrokinHealin.description: Heavy melee that protects allies with Overguard, or damage reduction if Tenno.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/OrokinNullif.name: Corrupted Nullifier
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/OrokinNullif.description: Energy shield blocks projectiles and nullifies powers

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/SandmanBoss/.name: Tomb Protector Effigy
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/SandmanBoss/.description: Awoken by the Protector to help defend the Tomb of Inaros.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/SandmanBoss/.name: Tomb Protector
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/SandmanBoss/.description: Watches over the Tomb of Inaros.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Aerolyst/.name: Aerolyst
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Aerolyst/.description: A support unit that can heal fellow Sentients. Canisters located near this units center of mass appear weaker than the surrounding carapace.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Brachioly.name: Brachiolyst
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Brachioly.description: Flying unit that can swoop down into melee.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Condrix/S.name: Condrix
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Condrix/S.description: This dropship ferries Sentient units from deep-space to battle zones around the Origin System.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Condrix/S.name: Orphix
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Condrix/S.description: These massive Sentients emit pulses that disable machinery, and deploy lesser Sentients that help to boost the pulse field. They have recently learned to disable Warframes.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Dolicholy.name: Summulyst
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Dolicholy.description: A high-order Sentient that bifurcates its body, creating a portal it uses to summon reinforcements and projectiles. Armed with twin cannons.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.name: Choralyst
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.description: These ethereal Sentients attack with both a sonic barrage and a thunderous homing orb.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.name: Eidolon Teralyst
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.description: An ancient Eidolon, searching for its lost brethren. Trying to make itself whole.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.name: Eidolon Gantulyst
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.description: A massive, lumbering, brute of an Eidolon.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.name: Eidolon Hydrolyst
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.description: The energy contained within this Eidolon is powerful enough to alter the local weather system.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.name: Eidolon Vomvalyst
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.description: A lost soul. Part energy, part physical shell, these Sentient remnants seem to have a symbiotic relationship with the much larger Eidolons.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Ortholyst.name: Ortholyst
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Ortholyst.description: This lightweight Sentient mounts itself to solid ground in order to deploy massive long range cannons.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Symbilyst.name: Symbilyst

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/SpaceBattles/Sentie.description: A heavy Sentient fighter that weakens targets with a slicing plasma wave and finishes them off with a massive energy orb.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxArche.name: Anarch Arcus
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxArche.description: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. It was not uncommon to witness Dax rangers supporting Tenno as they first leanrt to control their Warframes, filling in offensive gaps with precise aim.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxHeavy.name: Anarch Libritor
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxHeavy.description: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. Across many operations, the thunderous salvo of a Libritor Archgun served as a signal for hidden Dax forced to emerge from the shadows and fall upon their enemies like a guillotine's blade.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxMedic.name: Anarch Capsarii
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxMedic.description: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch dfaction. With shield above and staff in hand, Dax medics are as adept at healing as their brethren are at cutting down the opposition.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxNinja.name: Anarch Tenebra
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxNinja.description: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. While their ability and disappearing techniques allowed these Dax to quell revolts before they had formed in earnest, their experiences allowed for their own rebellion to to flourish where all others have failed.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxSword.name: Anarch Gladius
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxSword.description: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch dfaction. Within the minds of those dedicated to the blade lies a singular focus; to annihilate their enemy in the most effective manner possible.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Grineer/TauGrin.name: Anarch Grineer Lancer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Grineer/TauGrin.description: A cloned soldier in top fighting form. Lancers formed the front line of the Orokin legions, advancing relentlessly to carry the full might of the army deep into enemy territory. Lancers were chosen for sheer-minded determination, the ones who found it hard to let go of an idea.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Grineer/TauGrin.name: Anarch Grineer Trapper
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Grineer/TauGrin.description: Only the most cunning of clone stock are chosen to become trappers. These are given training in the operation of Trapper Drones by Archimedea; many do not make it through the training. Trappers are frequently ostracized from their squads due to mishaps while they are learning to aim.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/GuiltSentient/S.name: Dactolyst
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/GuiltSentient/S.description: Sentient Dactolyst, taken and twisted by the Anarch Galastra. Given the designation TQ-776VL by his captor, if the had taken an independent name before this, it has been lost.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Oda.name: Protea Specter
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Oda.description: The victim and beneficiary of Parvos Granum's research into Specter Particle Theory, this is all that remains of the Protea Warframe who sacrificed herself to keep Granum safe in a pocket realm beyond time.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.name: Oraxia
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.description: A servitor to Albrecht Entrati, she was bound to the protection of Scholar’s Landing. However, long years of isolation made her vulnerable to the manipulative whispers of Neci Rusalka. Now, she serves a new master, and attacks anyone who dares set foot on the isle.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.name: Scuttler
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.description: Spiderlings born from the guardian of Scholar's Landing. Though precious to their mother, an explosively short life leaves only the hunt to bond over.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.name: Scuttlers
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.description: Spiderlings born from the guardian of Scholar's Landing. Though precious to their mother, an explosively short life leaves only the hunt to bond over.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.name: Death Scuttler
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.description: These aggressive and explosive Scuttlers have one purpose to fulfil in their short lives; protect their mother.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.name: Death Scuttlers
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.description: These aggressive and explosive Scuttlers have one purpose to fulfil in their short lives; protect their mother.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Syn.name: Kavor Defector
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Syn.description: Grineer defectors in search of a better, more peaceful life.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: Techrot Obsolyte
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.description: Even redundant technology is given new life through the Technocyte Virus.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: Techrot Babau (Temporal Archimedea Survival)
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.description: The rapid decay of human ingenuity produces daemons. Often found growing on neglected Hell-Scrubbers.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: Techrot Babau
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.description: The rapid decay of human ingenuity produces daemons. Often found growing on neglected Hell-Scrubbers.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: Techrot Miasmite
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.description: These tiny nodules of Techrot are the diabolic union of an arc welder and a gas can. Usually attacking in groups, they explode as soon as they near their target.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: Techrot Skuzzi
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.description: Once a simple workstation, the servant has turned against its former masters.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: Techrot Galliflex
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.description: This aggressive melee unit dashes at enemies, lashing out with frenzied strikes.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: Techrot Matmas
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.description: This tottering, bulbous Techrot creation can inflate bladders to become airborne, raining down destruction on those below.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: Techrot Volatile Galliflex
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.description: This self-sacrificing unit ignites its subsumed propane tank and then charges its prey, for the survival of the Hive.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Disru.name: Scaldra Screamer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Disru.description: Specialized Scaldra demoltions unit, with an impressive vocal range.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.name: Scaldra Flayer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.description: Quick and lethal. This Scaldra unit has been trained to rush the target and inflict maximum damage with their curved blades.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.name: Scaldra Dedicant
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.description: This heavily armored, slow moving unit lays down the law with dual Efervon cannons.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.name: Scaldra Harbinger
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.description: This automated aerial unit tracks and triangulates its target with lasers and then fires a high caliber rifle shot.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.name: Scaldra TI-92
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.description: This armored personnel carrier is designed to move Scaldra forces quickly and easily around Höllvania. Its roof mounted turret provides lethal defense.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.name: Scaldra Eradicator
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.description: This support unit smokes out its target with gas grenades and finishes the job with blows from his massive club.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.name: Scaldra Jaeger
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.description: This rifle unit has been trained to suppress the enemy with volley after volley of machine gun fire.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.name: Scaldra Barbican
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.description: Sporting a ballistic shield, this heavy unit closes the distance while laying down pistol fire. Carries an Efervon gel cannon.

Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Grine.name: Drudge Brazer
Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/AIWeek/Grine.description: Proficient with tools used for smelting.
